ID_keys.service_id: SVC-NNN; one contracted service per vendor
ID_keys.application_id: APP-NNN from the shared application catalog
ID_keys.source_document_id: Document catalog key with PDF and Markdown paths

types.*_usd_cents: Integer US cents; divide by 100 for display
types.null: Missing or not applicable, never assumed to be zero

grains.finance: one invoice line and forecast allocation per vendor/month
grains.risk: one latest assessment state, which may be stale or missing

ingestion: Each vendor JSON file is its class source. Shared reference JSON files provide dimensions. PDF and Markdown are equivalent renditions of the same document_id; index one rendition, not both. Catalog, golden-question and QA files are supporting metadata, not extra business facts.
